name: dadaapi-image2-plugin
description: 哒哒API Image2 is a local GPT Image compatible Codex plugin for generating, editing, extracting, and previewing image assets.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and edit images with 哒哒API previews
interface.longDescription: Use 哒哒API Image2 to generate images, edit images, extract opaque assets from flattened designs, and run async image jobs from Codex. Choose GPT Image 2.5 Flare for fast everyday generation or GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst for demanding quality and precise editing; set IMAGE2_MODEL in ~/.codex/image2-mcp.env. Use gpt-image-2 when GPT Image 2.5 is unavailable to your API key or channel. The plugin saves output locally and returns generated images as inline previews whenever possible.
defaultPrompt: 帮我选择这个插件的图像模型：Flare 适合快速日常生成，Sunburst 适合高要求成图和精细编辑。请按我的用途推荐，并告诉我如何设置 IMAGE2_MODEL。
Generate an image and show me the preview
Edit this image and preview the result
Extract transparent elements from this design
